title: enhanced-canary-ab-shadow-rollback-workflow
author: Lucas Meyer
description: Summary: Add an enhanced rollback workflow for unified rollouts that combines canary, A/B, and shadow traffic probes with metric-driven automatic rollback and integrated observability. Motivation: customers need safer progressive rollouts across hosted/dedicated/private modes; existing autorollback covers simple canaries but lacks multi-stage probing, AB gating, and shadow-based degradation detection. This PR implements a modular workflow orchestrator, new probe types, and observability hooks used by the console and alerting.

feat(rollouts): add AB-gate policy and multi-stage canary sequencing

Priya Patel: UX review — requested clearer attribution of which traffic (canary/ab/shadow) caused an autorollback in the console timeline. Asked for a changelog entry.
Evan Zhang: Approved after changes. Verified test coverage and CI green on rerun. Noted one nit about log level for debug traces.
